name: auction-new
description: Real-time reverse (and forward) auction tool. A modern rewrite of auction-machine.

scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting,firestore:rules
scripts.test:rules: PATH="$(brew --prefix openjdk)/bin:$PATH" firebase emulators:exec --only firestore "vitest run --config vitest.rules.config.ts"
scripts.test:e2e: PATH="$(brew --prefix openjdk)/bin:$PATH" firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore "playwright test"
